entities.name: Vishnuvardhana

entities.summary: Wisnuwardhana, also known as Jayawisnuwardhana, alias Nararya Seminingrat, was king of Tumapel from 1248 until his death in 1268 under the regnal title: Śrī Jayawisnuwarddhana Sang Mapāñji Seminingrat Śrī Sakala Kalana Kulama Dhumardana Kamalekṣana.
